ZAFIRA

Exclusive Private Event

Some Doors Were Never Meant To Be Opened… Only To Choose Who Enters.

An invitation-only experience for authentic individuals seeking high-level connections. Elegance, absolute privacy, and curated encounters.

Gentlemen → Ladies → Invitation Only  |  Not a Dating App
Application Process

Your Path to Evento Zafira

An exclusive process designed to find the special person.

01

Initial Application

Complete your application and share the necessary information to begin your process.

02

Preliminary Review

At no cost. We read your application and, only if your profile can move forward, we explain the next step.

03

Evaluation & Verification · USD 400

Covers the study, the evaluation and the background verification. It does not reserve a place and is not part of the programme; it is non-refundable once the evaluation begins.

04

Official Confirmation

If selected, you will receive official approval to continue.

05

Program Access

After approval, you make the single payment for the programme (USD 13,000).

Discover our process (Gentlemen) Apply Now →
Colombia · By Invitation Only

The Zafira Event

After verification and official confirmation, you will be invited to a private gathering in Colombia. There you will meet, in person, those who after verification also agreed to meet you.

Private Event  ·  Accompanied by Zafira
Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions Cancellations & Refunds About Contact
